mapper.select: select d.ftr_id, IFNULL(e.ftr_name, '因子已删除') as ftr_name, e.remark from stt_scene_factor d left join stt_factor e on d.ftr_id = e.ftr_id where d.scene_id = #{scene_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select * from ( select @rownum:=@rownum+1 AS rowno, a.* from (SELECT @rownum:=0) r,stt_scene a where a.scene_id like concat_ws('','%' ,#{sceneId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%') and a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001' order by a.scene_id) r where r.rowno <= 50

select * from ( select @rownum:=@rownum+1 AS rowno, UTL_MATCH.edit_distance_similarity(a.scene_name, #{sceneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) as similarity, a.* from (SELECT @rownum:=0) r,stt_scene a where a.scene_name like concat_ws('','%' ,#{sceneName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%' and a.scene_tpml_id='FlowTestModel0001' order by similarity desc) r where r.rowno <= 50
